text:
Kathy owns the Miami condominium outright by survivorship under the tenancy by the entirety created by Bill’s signed and delivered deed, so that property never entered the probate estate. Tommy takes the Deerwoods pasture under the will, and Tommy and Julie share every other asset equally. Kathy’s prenuptial waiver of the rights arising from the marriage leaves her with nothing further from the estate.

CONFIDENCE: 84
